title: Crop and encode chronological occurrences

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification passed FT-003-AC-005: real Chromium over the central HTTPS origin proved exact centered 1.2x geometry, edge clamping without shift/padding, fractional source coordinates with deterministic round-to-nearest output dimensions, proportional 512px downscale, no-upscale, sRGB JPEG output without EXIF, and all six caller quality inputs. Static scope checks found no trigger/ring/multipart/server/quality-persistence leakage; lifecycle remains in_progress.
TASK-048 T2 closure is authorized by fresh /verify PASS; implementation and all task-owned gates are complete. No per-task /red-verify is required for T2.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-005 RED: occurrence transformation is absent; GREEN: every fixture bbox produces a clipped centered square of side 1.2 x max(width,height), is never aligned/upscaled, is proportionally reduced only when its long side exceeds 512, and encodes as sRGB JPEG without EXIF/source metadata; decisive comparison: edge, fractional, below/above-512 and metadata fixtures compare decoded dimensions/pixels and metadata; artifact: Playwright transcript and decoded output under .tasks/TASK-048-T2-FT-003-W2/.
purpose: Implement only the deterministic occurrence crop/downscale/JPEG transformation consumed by multipart formation.
success_outcome: Each ordered occurrence becomes one compliant bounded JPEG without owning user-selectable quality configuration.
anti_goals: Do not implement JPEG quality UI/persistence, detector traversal or multipart formation.
Do not align, normalize, upscale, rank, quality-gate or upload full frames.
Do not introduce a graphics/ML runtime beyond browser primitives.

stop_conditions: Exact geometry/metadata behavior cannot be proved from browser output.
Encoding requires a new ML/graphics runtime.

constraints: Use browser-native image operations in real Chromium over deterministic fixtures.
Accept the selected quality as an input supplied by TASK-062 without implementing or persisting it.
Use disposable artifacts and retain proof under the task directory.
invariants: Geometry is clipped centered-square 1.2x with no alignment or upscale.
Long side is at most 512 and JPEG is sRGB without source metadata.
Quality selection/persistence is not this task's claim.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-005 boundary geometry, resizing and metadata fixtures.
Integration seam accepts each allowed quality input without proving UI persistence.
